title: Sarvestan Palace
scope: Sarvestan’s standing ruin: three front bays, large brick cupola, small domed rooms, barrel-vaulted flanks, and open rear courtyard.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The excavation report identifies a 45 x 37 m compound, iwans, domes and vaulted areas built with brick and stone. Written facts only.
Oleg Grabar describes a nearly 13 m central domed room, main entry bay, two side bays, southern long vaulted hall with a small dome, north iwan and east courtyard. Written facts only.
Confirms the identity and geographic location of component 1568-008.

limitations: The model represents the standing and restored ruin with exposed masonry, no theoretical original roof reconstruction.
Roof and wall losses, decayed ornament, secondary room dividers, roof profiles and elevations are approximate. Modern maintenance equipment and visitor infrastructure are excluded.
Original terrain stays unchanged and fixes approximate grade, not survey thresholds.
